title: CT Signal
description: Connecticut data answers to the questions its news cycle is already asking. Every number fetched, never written.

items.title: How safe is Connecticut compared with the rest of the country?
items.content_text: Connecticut reports 147 violent crimes per 100k people (2023) — the 3rd-safest of the 52 peers (50 states, DC and Puerto Rico).. Triggered by: California Couple Charged With Murder in Shooting of Son-in-Law

items.title: Is Connecticut's job market doing better or worse than the rest of the country?
items.content_text: Connecticut's unemployment rate is 5.8% (2026) — the 3rd-highest among the 52 peers (50 states, DC and Puerto Rico).. Triggered by: Job growth cools as unemployment edges up in several states

items.title: How many Connecticut residents live below the poverty line compared with the rest of the country?
items.content_text: 9.6% of Connecticut residents live below the poverty line (2024) — the 10th-lowest poverty rate among the 52 peers (50 states, DC and Puerto Rico).. Triggered by: [civic calendar] Fall safety-net and benefits enrollment coverage

items.title: Which Connecticut towns grew their property tax base fastest?
items.content_text: Bridgeport added $4.85B of net taxable property in 2025 (+59.9%), the fastest of 169 towns.. Triggered by: [civic calendar] 2026 general election (governor's race)

items.title: How expensive is renting in Connecticut compared to the rest of America?
items.content_text: Connecticut's median gross rent was $1,488 in 2024 — the 17th-highest among the 52 peers (50 states, DC and Puerto Rico).. Triggered by: Renters battered by record shelter costs, national report finds
